panels.gesture: Brief genuinely puzzled expression, mouth slightly parted and eyebrows uncertain; one open hand paused halfway through a sentence near his chest, the other relaxed low, gaze searching the listener. Subtle lapse, no caricature or exaggerated vacant stare.

Thoughtful searching eyes glance upward, brows gently drawn; fingertips lightly scratching the beard at the side of his chin, other hand supporting that elbow. He is trying to recall an old herald's name.

An almost welcoming recognition followed by a hint of uncertainty in the eyes; one palm offered toward the unseen visitor, the other fingertips touching his own chest, slight head tilt. Preserve all age lines and dignity.

Chin lifted to recover poise, one eyebrow arched and mouth forming a brisk matter-of-fact reply; one hand turns outward in a small assured flourish, other hand rests flat over his lower ribs. Pride hiding a momentary mistake.

Suddenly lucid intelligent focus, concentrated but pleased eyes; one forefinger traces a short imaginary connection in the air above the other open palm. No drawn lines, names, diagrams, text, or symbols.
Warm proud smile that preserves his long angular elderly face, eyes bright and soft; both hands open gently apart near the waist as if describing the children's achievements, shoulders relaxed.

A restrained sincere appreciative smile and courteous small head incline; one hand placed over the heart, the other open toward the unseen recipient, fingers relaxed. Gratitude for good service rather than a regal command.

Tender restrained melancholy, eyes lowered slightly sideways, mouth gently closed; fingertips lightly touching the teal fabric near the gold clasp, opposite forearm resting across the lower torso. Grief without tears, sobbing, apparitions, or melodrama.

An unusually peaceful soft closed-mouth smile and gently lowered eyelids; hands loosely nested together low at the waist, shoulders unknotted, head inclined slightly. Still the same stern old man in a rare quiet mood, never younger or broadly grinning.
